Sourcing

Where our information comes from.

Technical explanations draw on general engineering practice and the published documentation of Australian regulators and state programs. Each article lists its sources, and the rebates page records the date each program was last verified against its official page.

We do not publish statistics we cannot attribute, and we do not describe a government program as active without checking it. When a program closes — as Victoria's interest-free battery loan has — we say so rather than quietly removing it.
